accessibleReadySnapshot.name: Give old databases a new place to work
Give old databases a new place to work
accessibleReadySnapshot.text: Give old databases a new place to work
Open an .mdb or .accdb file: Open Database Studio builds an editable working copy from it. The original stays unchanged.
Edit data with type checking, run queries in Access SQL and save results as CSV.
Automatic forms, a simple designer and reports with groups and totals, printable as PDF.
Run VBA procedures sandboxed on the working copy: only on request, without files, COM or Shell.
Everything happens locally. Macros, AutoExec and VBA are never run automatically. Save your work as an .sqlite working copy and reopen it later via Open.
